result.summary: The main issue found is the lack of content for the pizza restaurant shown at the bottom of the screen, which appears cut off and incomplete.

issues.description: The restaurant card at the bottom of the screen is truncated (cut off), showing only the pizza image and a '-20%' badge without a name, rating, delivery time, or cost.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the vertical layout or scroll padding so that the bottom card is fully visible or indicates more content is available to scroll to.
